Today's ancestry check is insensitive to this (it checks the post-merge SHA itself, not branch-tip ancestry), but a future parent-shape-sensitive check would silently pass here where a real squash would fail.

Claim under doubt: genuine wave concurrency, not a call-order artifact — Both worktrees are created/committed sequentially in one process; this proves isolation under sequential composition, not contention-safety under true concurrent runners racing loop.lock.
